name: Alexandru Balasz
goals:
Experience an unique and immersive D&D gameplay
Have fun with friends on weekends
Keep track of the fundamental game events and mechanics in a seamless way
frustrations:
Sometimes, it's hard to gather and meet all of your friends for a D&D campaign. An RPG app would help to create a fun experience which blends the original on-site nature of the game with the virtual alternative.
The centralization of all the information requires a lot of physical resources (books, paper, minifigures). 
The game is very complicated for new players
scenarios: In a general case, for a primary persona, the main usage is for when he wants to keep track of personal stats and quests, instead of searching for the character sheet through tens of pieces of paper; he opens the smartphone app and gets all the information in one place. The smartwatch helps him analyze short-term data or maybe even rolling the dice. Need to spice things up in your on-site gathering with your friends? VR Googles! Turn into your imaginary character: grow elvish ears, a dragon tail or a long white wizard beard. It will be more fun to actually try and roleplay your character. For a Dungeon Master, you can create and post Quests for the other players and manage how enemies behave on the map.
otherDetails: Usually is Dungeon Master and preffers longer campaigns (6 months+).
